drivers.name: North America pricing and margin recovery
drivers.last_report: Q2 NA net sales -1.5% organic, EBIT margin 2.7% vs 5.9%; sequential margin +240bps on pricing; tariffs/raw materials/fuel and lower volume pressured.
drivers.guidance: Full-year largest price increase in over a decade; structural cost takeout to deliver >$150M/100bps.

drivers.name: Latin America Brazil margin turnaround
drivers.last_report: Q2 Latin America net sales +7.8%, organic -1.7%; EBIT margin 3.0% vs 6.0%, hurt by negative Brazil price/mix despite volume increase and tax gain.
drivers.guidance: Announced price increase and structural cost actions to restore margins in Brazil.

drivers.name: Structural cost take-out delivery
drivers.last_report: Q2 restructuring costs $41M; progress on cost take-out; full-year structural savings targeted >$150M. H1 restructuring $73M.
drivers.guidance: Structural cost take out to deliver over $150 million or 100 basis points of margin expansion.

drivers.name: SDA Global sell-out and inventory
drivers.last_report: Q2 SDA organic net sales -1.2% on lower retailer inventory despite strong sell-out; EBIT margin 11.9% vs 17.3% on marketing investments and product launches.

drivers.name: Interest expense and free cash flow
drivers.last_report: Q2 interest expense $63M; closed $2B ABL and $2B secured bonds; cleared maturities until 2028; EPS outlook cut for new interest expense.
drivers.guidance: 2026 operating cash ~$700M; FCF >$300M; net debt below $5.0B; EPS revised for new interest expense.

card.guidance: Full year 2026: net sales ~$15.0B; ongoing EBIT margin ~4.0%; GAAP EPS $2.25-$2.75; ongoing EPS $2.50-$3.00; operating cash ~$700M; FCF >$300M; net debt below $5.0B.
kill_conditions: North America organic sales or segment EBIT margin declines further despite pricing actions.
Brazil price increases fail, leaving Latin America EBIT margin near 3.0% or lower.
Cost take-out savings delayed, restructuring charges rise, or free cash flow misses >$300M target.
